source.description: DMC Article 117 identities from the official January 2021 numerical list (SHA-256 b73918371ddc8f6a8cfea13897151e575143dfcc4b55850d3dac3b6c8329238e); approximate screen sRGB for 454 legacy solid colors from QuiltySolid's July 2025 MIT-licensed JSON snapshot (SHA-256 216c306f6113df7ba8c61ca41b1451464e33950343482a90df71862c9939ed14). The remaining 35 official colors are retained with unknown appearance. Names are descriptive; DMC identifies colors by code. Values are not physical stitched-swatch measurements.
